lines.text: Cornelius, a devout centurion in the Italian Regiment at Caesarea, gave generously to the people and prayed regularly.
An angel told Cornelius to send men to Antioch for Simon called Peter, who was staying with Simon the tanner.
Cornelius sent two servants and a devout soldier, and the next day Peter went up on the roof to pray.
Peter saw a large sheet lowered from heaven holding animals, and a voice told him to kill and eat, which happened five times.
The Spirit told Peter to go with the three men, and the next day he went with them.
